two_way_anova_decomposition.interpretation: Balanced repeated-measures ANOVA demonstrates that stable text differences (object main effect) account for only 4.23% of total stance variance (F=0.81, p=0.92, null). Framework main effects account for 28.30% (F=49.92, p=1.11e-16), and object-by-framework interactions account for 67.47%.

relational_stance_model.grouping_verification: Strictly article-level grouped KFold: all K=14 framework scores for article i are partitioned together into training or testing folds, ensuring zero leakage of article text across folds.
relational_stance_model.interpretation: Balanced repeated-measures ANOVA reveals that stable article-intrinsic differences account for only 4.23% of total variance (F=0.81, p=0.92, null), framework main effects account for 28.30% (F=49.92, p=1.11e-16), and article-by-framework interactions account for 67.47%. Under multi-output prediction of the 14-dimensional stance profile, article-only representations capture framework means but only 15% to 23% of within-framework variance (macro R2 = 0.15 for Weak/TF-IDF, 0.19 for MiniLM, 0.23 for DeBERTa), confirming that stance is neither purely in the text nor purely imposed by the framework, but arises substantially from their interaction.
